excluded.cand001-cand003: already REJECTED_INITIAL_EXPERIMENT with negative gross expectancy per trade; re-running them would spend this experiment's sample on a refuted mechanism
excluded.cross_sectional_rotation: REJECT at WP-EDGE-015 and degenerate on three assets: a top-k rotation over BTC/ETH/SOL is a single-asset trend rule with extra steps
excluded.maker_only_spread_capture: DEFER_NO_FILL_MODEL, and EXP-003M now prices the fill side of it

cost_model.components: fee + half spread + slippage + impact per side, on both legs; the fee floor is the comparable minimum, the full round trip is the gate
cost_model.source: trading_bot.research.economic_recovery.alpha15.cost_for (the same model EXP-003L and EXP-003M priced)

decision_rules.ADVANCE_TO_VALIDATION: S1, S2, S3 and S4 hold and the closed-trade view in VAL is net positive after full cost
decision_rules.EXPERIMENT: S1 holds and S2/S3 do not: the signal carries information this sample cannot turn into money
decision_rules.INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE: S0 fails, or the measurement depends on an input the experiment cannot verify
decision_rules.NO_VIABLE_CANDIDATES: no candidate reaches ADVANCE_TO_VALIDATION; the refuted hypotheses are listed with the measured deficit
decision_rules.REJECT: S1 fails, or S1 holds but S3 shows the gross cannot cover even the fee floor

exit_policy.entry: open of the bar after the decision bar, plus the adverse price terms of the cost model
exit_policy.exit: open of the bar 12 bars later, or the stop level if the stop is touched first
exit_policy.intrabar: stop_first: when a bar holds both the stop and the horizon price, the stop is taken

gates.S0_sample: a cell needs >= 50 signals in RESEARCH, >= 20 in IS and >= 15 in VAL; below that the verdict is INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE, never a pass
gates.S1_existence: in IS, the mean signed forward return at some horizon > 0 and its bootstrap 95% lower bound > 0
gates.S2_replication: the same horizon has a positive mean in VAL, a block the horizon was not chosen on
gates.S3_economic: VAL mean gross - full round-trip cost (fee + half spread + slippage + impact at 500 USDT) > 0, and the VAL mean gross at least covers the fee floor (20 bps, or 15 bps with the BNB discount)
gates.S4_multiple_testing: the cell survives Benjamini-Hochberg at q = 0.10 inside its stage's test family
gates.S5_holdout_integrity: no input row, signal or statistic covers 2026-08-06 -> 2026-08-20; the holdout is never read
gates.S6_governance: config/runtime.yaml still declares paper with live_trading_enabled false, no live order exists, and this experiment changes no risk limit
gates.S7_null_baseline: a coin-flip signal with the same cadence and the same exit policy must fail S1-S4; if it does not, the gates are measuring costs and not edge

holdout.rule: no bar, signal, trade or statistic for this window is produced, stored or summarised; the runner and the verifier both refuse a row inside it

prior_evidence.EXP-003L: the taker round trip is ~25.4 bps at 500 USDT; the best configuration's gross was 8.5 bps per trade and every other cell was negative
prior_evidence.EXP-003M: 5m/mean_reversion REJECT: the maker fill ceiling is 0.2669 USDT per closed trade against a 0.75 USDT fee floor (0.356x coverage)
prior_evidence.SOURCE-TO-RUNTIME: all five cand001-cand003 arms REJECTED_INITIAL_EXPERIMENT with negative gross expectancy per trade
prior_evidence.STRATEGY_ADMISSION: the authoritative ledger records NO_GROSS_EDGE or COST_KILLED for all 24 (family, timeframe) cells; the largest zero-cost gross is volatility@30m at 8.91 bps
prior_evidence.WP-EDGE-015: NO_ECONOMIC_EDGE_FOUND on the 1h alt corpora: trend_pullback REJECT, vol_regime_breakout REJECT_OUTLIER_DRIVEN, mean_reversion_vol_liq EXPERIMENT_COST_FRAGILE, cross_sectional_rotation REJECT, maker hypothesis DEFER_NO_FILL_MODEL

question: Does any mechanism that already exists in this repository produce a gross income per signal that covers its own round-trip cost on valid, point-in-time bars?

bootstrap.method: moving block bootstrap over signals ordered in time
bootstrap.unit: signed forward return in bps per signal

multiple_testing.family: every (candidate, horizon) cell tested in stage 1, then every surviving cell in stage 2

why_not_another_fill_model: EXP-003M measured that 5m/mean_reversion's most generous fill model still earns 0.2669 USDT per closed trade against a 0.75 USDT fee floor. Modelling fills more carefully cannot create gross income; only a different gross can.
